payload.body_they: {{Name}} may know exactly what they mean and still spend more time than expected getting it into words. They notice context, exceptions, and the detail that changes the meaning, which can make them a thoughtful communicator. The complication is when being understood starts mattering more than saying what they actually think. Their strongest communication comes from knowing which part they can stand behind and saying that clearly.
